verses.tl: Sabbaha Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo lima taqooloona maa laa taf'aloon
Kabura maqtan indallaahi an taqooloo maa laa taf'aloon
Innallaaha yuhibbul-ladheena yuqaatiloona fee sabeelihi saffan ka'annahum bunyaanun marsoos
Wa idh qaala moosaa liqawmihi yaa qawmi lima tu'udhoonanee wa qad ta'lamoona annee rasoolullaahi ilaykum falammaa zaaghoo azaagha Allaahu quloobahum Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen

Wa idh qaala eesab-nu maryama yaa banee israa'eela innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wa mubashshiran birasoolin ya'tee min ba'dee usmuhu ahmadu falammaa jaa'ahum bil-bayyinaati qaaloo haadhaa sihrun mubeen
Wa man azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahil-kadhiba wa huwa yud'aa ilal-islaami Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Yureedoona liyutfi'oo noora Allaahi bi-afwaahihim Wallaahu mutimmu noorihi wa law karihal-kaafiroon
Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahu bil-hudaa wa deenil-haqqi liyuzhirahu alad-deeni kullihi wa law karihal-mushrikoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo hal adullukum alaa tijaaratin tunjeekum min adhaabin aleem
Tu'minoona Billaahi wa rasoolihi wa tujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi bi-amwaalikum wa anfusikum dhaalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
Yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum wa yudkhilkum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wa masaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati adnin dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Wa ukhraa tuhibboonahaa nasrun mina Allaahi wa fathun qareebun wa bashshiril-mu'mineen

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonw ansaara Allaahi kamaa qaala eesab-nu maryama lilhawaariyyeena man ansaaree ilaa Allaahi qaalal-hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaaru Allaahi fa-aamanat taa'ifatun min banee israa'eela wa kafarat taa'ifatun fa-ayyadnal-ladheena aamanoo alaa aduwwihim fa-asbahoo zaahireen
